verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad public API surface. It covers event ingestion (HTTP V2), event export, Dashboard REST data retrieval, cohort list/export/upload, taxonomy CRUD, and Experiment APIs for managing flags and experiments from scripts or CI. A probe confirmed a published openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through these APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Send data directly from your server to the HTTP V2 endpoint.
Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
Create, get, update, and delete categories, event types, event properties, and user properties.
Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
List all your cohorts in Amplitude, export a cohort in Amplitude, or upload a cohort.
